announced on Wednesday that Malaysia Aviation Group (MAG) selected its GEnx-1B engines to power up to 16 Boeing
This is the first time MAG has chosen GEnx engines for its fleet, extending its nearly three-decade partnership with GE Aerospace.
The company said the engines offer better fuel efficiency, reliability, and durability for long-haul flights.
MAG also renewed its agreement to use GE Aerospace's Fuel Insight and FlightPulse software to improve fuel efficiency, reduce emissions, and support safer flights.

title: GE Aerospace wins Boeing 787 engine deal; expands Malaysia partnership
